_about: Public-domain Daniel Steele (1824-1914, Methodist holiness theologian, Boston University) for the Word Hoard: Love Enthroned (1875), Mile-Stone Papers (1878), Half-Hours with St. Paul (1895), A Defense of Christian Perfection (1896), The Gospel of the Comforter (1897) and Half-Hours with St. John's Epistles (1901), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

dsteele-love-enthroned: Love Enthroned: Essays on Evangelical Perfection (New York: Nelson & Phillips, 1875)
